0022600171.text: The LA Clippers (1-4, 1-1 at home, 0-3 on the road) enter this home game on a four-game losing streak, 13th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Pacific. The Toronto Raptors (3-2) are 5th in the East, 2 games back in the Atlantic, and coming off a loss, with Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) all out. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and the teams have no games yet this season, though the Clippers won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 119-94 win in Los Angeles on March 25, 2026.
